description: Cancel an order. Whether cancellation is possible depends on the order's current status. The optional owner reason is retained only in the MCP conversation/tool log; the KIT CancelOrder endpoint has no reason field, so it is not sent to or stored by the KIT API. No request body is required.

reason.description: Owner-provided cancellation reason for conversation and tool-log context only; it is not sent to or stored by the KIT API.

name: cancel_order
title: Cancel order
